trafficReport.title: Storefront traffic
trafficReport.definition: Visitors, visits and page views come from traffic measurement and use different counting rules from the recorded shopping activities below. Breakdown rows count visitors, not visits. A visitor can appear in several rows; do not add them together. Sources hide URL details for privacy and can appear more than once. Bars compare the rows on this page. These figures cover the selected dates, not the comparison period.
trafficReport.limited: Showing the top {count} entries. Search and pagination apply to this selection, not all traffic entries.
trafficReport.unavailableHelp: Recorded shopping activity is shown separately below. You can refresh to try again.
trafficReport.empty: No traffic entries in this selection
trafficReport.emptyHelp: Try different dates or clear the search. No recorded traffic does not prove there were no visitors.

demand.overlap: {count} products share these values. Select again to cycle through them, or use the list.
demand.title: Product signals
demand.definition: Compare how often products were viewed with how many units were ordered. Each bar uses its own scale, so use the numbers for exact values.
demand.signalHint: Interest and orders, side by side
demand.olderActivity: Some older product activity cannot be connected to a current product, so it is not included in this comparison.
demand.missingSales: Order quantities are not ready for these dates. Recorded product interest is still available.
demand.unlinked: {count} older or incomplete product events could not be matched to sales. They remain in the list without order quantities.
demand.emptyHelp: Try other dates or clear the search. Products appear when orders or product activity are recorded.
demand.mapScope: Map shows matched products on this page. Further right means more recorded viewing visits; higher means more units ordered. The scale changes with this selection.
demand.mapLabel: Product interest and order quantity map
demand.noMapHelp: You can still inspect recorded activity in the list. A missing quantity is not zero.
demand.unlinkedRow: This activity could not be safely matched to a product’s orders.
demand.failed: Product interest could not be loaded. Please refresh and try again.

storefrontReport.title: Shopping activity
storefrontReport.scope: Recorded visits, not checkout conversion. Select an activity to see where it happened.
storefrontReport.definition: Each activity counts distinct recorded sessions during the chosen dates. One session can appear in several activities. These are independent counts, not an ordered funnel. Completed orders are not linked to these sessions. Blocking tracking or missing events can reduce the recorded counts.
storefrontReport.failed: Shopping activity could not be loaded. Please refresh and try again.
storefrontReport.missingSessions: {count} recorded events could not be linked to a visit and are excluded from these counts.
storefrontReport.noEventsHelp: This may mean there were no visits, or tracking did not record them. Try a different date range.
storefrontReport.pathsHelp: Pages where the selected activity was recorded. A visit can appear on several pages, so these rows must not be added together as unique visits. Query strings are removed for privacy.

variants.title: Product variants
variants.description: Quantities ordered during the selected report dates, grouped by variant.

range.historyHelp: Available history selects the dates ready for reporting. It may not include your shop’s full history. Earlier dates can have missing data.

contributions.scaleHelp: Bars use the same scale for every product on this page. The scale adjusts when you search, sort, or change pages. Open a product to see paid and unpaid quantities.
contributions.title: Products ordered
contributions.description: See which products customers ordered most. Compare the quantity with the previous period to spot rising or falling demand. Biggest change shows the largest increases or decreases first.
contributions.emptyDescription: Try another name or date range.
contributions.definition: Includes paid and unpaid orders, but not cancelled orders. Returned items have not been deducted. Product names are the names recorded when ordered.
contributions.failed: Product details could not be loaded
contributions.retry: Try refreshing the report. Sales above may still be available.
contributions.preparing: Product history is not ready for this range
contributions.coverage: A complete product record is needed to compare quantities. Request an update or choose a more recent range.

salesWorkspace.exportFailed: The export could not be downloaded. Please try again.
salesWorkspace.paidDefinition: Total value of non-cancelled orders currently marked paid, grouped by the day the order was placed. Includes delivery and taxes. This is not net revenue or the date money was received.
salesWorkspace.orderDefinition: Orders placed during the selected period, excluding cancelled orders. Includes both paid and unpaid orders.
salesWorkspace.preparing: Sales history is being prepared. Request an update above, then check again. Missing days are not counted as zero.
salesWorkspace.stale: These figures are from an earlier update. You can request a fresh report above.
salesWorkspace.partial: Some days in this range have not been verified. Available days are shown, but the full-period total is withheld.
salesWorkspace.noHistory: No verified history for this range
salesWorkspace.inspect: Inspect a period. Use the arrow keys or select a point on the chart.
salesWorkspace.invalidRange: Choose a valid date range of up to 366 complete days, ending yesterday or earlier.
salesWorkspace.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this shop’s Insights.
salesWorkspace.unavailable: Sales could not be loaded. Please try again.
